content.title: 8-2-4-4. Statutory mineral estate notices.
content.summary: The notification of mineral estate owners of the property which is the subject of a public hearing may be given by the Applicant in accordance with the law prior to the public hearing in accordance with the Colorado Notification of Surface Development Act, C.R.S. § 24-65.5-101, et seq.
